WHAT WAS ASKED — ROLE-SPECIFIC ACCOUNTS
A Graduate Engineer Trainee account reports an AMCAT test with 39 questions in 49 minutes, followed by technical and HR discussion. Topics included perfect-square testing, polymorphism, keys and SQL operations, deadlocks, concurrency and Java interfaces.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MTc4Mw

The database labels this record Reliance, while the narrative identifies Reliance Jio. It describes a one-hour InterviewBit test with two problems: minimum swaps to sort and moving balls into consecutive positions. Later work included a minimum-removal array-sum problem. Jio evidence should not be generalized to all Reliance businesses.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MTc4Mg

An SDE-II account names longest-consecutive-sequence and interval merging, followed by design patterns and an OTP login-system design. Later discussion covered distributed caches, eviction, SQL versus NoSQL, CAP and indexing.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MTc4NA

A NodeJS backend account includes JavaScript debounce/throttle, linked-list midpoint and tree traversals, plus React Native/mobile discussions. Role and business-unit fit should be checked before treating these as likely campus questions.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MTc4NQ
